sources.title: Prompt engineering best practices for 2026 | Claude by Anthropic
sources.snippet: What is prompt engineering? Prompt engineering is the craft of structuring instructions to get better outputs from AI models. It's how you phrase queries, specify style, provide context, and guide the model's behavior to achieve your goals. sources.title: Prompt Engineering Guide (Complete Techniques 2026)
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering is the art of writing instructions that get AI to give you exactly what you want. A great prompt can turn a mediocre AI response into a production-ready result. This 2026 guide covers every prompt engineering technique, role prompting, few-shot learning, chain of thought, ReAct, and more, with real examples that work.
